items.description: Electrician labour checking/rewiring flooded circuits, 12 hrs
items.rationale: The water came from surface flooding, which is inundation under the further natural hazards (2.1(c2), 2.5). Nothing shows that group was taken, so the bar in 3.6.1/3.6.2(b) applies to all labour.
Inundation is uninsured, and 3.6.2(f) bars every journey charge.
Inundation bar under 3.6.2(d). The pump is also working equipment, excluded by 4.3(d) and 5.2.2.
Working equipment, excluded by 4.3(d), 5.2.2 and 7.1.8(b). The whole claim is also barred because the inundation peril is not insured.
This is a loss-mitigation measure, but 3.6.2(d) bars such measures where the inundation group is not recorded in the schedule.
Materials are barred by 3.6.2(c), since the damage was caused by uninsured inundation.

items.description: Renew boiler incl. flue and storage tank
items.rationale: The plant was submerged by surface water. Escape of water is not established (2.4.3), and inundation is not insured, so 3.6.2(a) applies.

items.description: Adjust supply pipework for replacement boiler
items.rationale: Adaptation and connection work belonging to a replacement is expressly barred by 3.6.2(a).
Removal and disposal are barred by 3.6.2(e) and (g) because the inundation peril is uninsured.
Every journey charge is barred by 3.6.2(f). Even if cover applied, this would be a second journey charge, excluded by 7.1.8(d).
